sloka: न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन ।कलत्रवति सन्देहस्त्वय्यपि स्यादसंशयः ।। ५.३७.४६।।।।
transliteration: na ca śakṣye tvayā sārdhaṁ gantuṁ śatruvināśana ।kalatravati sandehastvayyapi syādasaṁśayaḥ ।। 5.37.46।।।।

translations.english: Fallen into the ocean teeming with whales, crocodiles and fish, I should at once become, helpless, excellent food for the aquatic creatures.
